Foundation managed instance 'oday-staging-foundation-sql' resides in VPC 'oday-staging-runtime' (private IP 10.149.0.3). Both instances must remain distinct; legacy instance remains preserved (not destroyed).

recovery_bucket_resolution_protocol.evidence_context: Preflight #1245 skipped bucket describe probes (argv [], exit null) due to unset variables; unset variables do NOT establish absence.
stage_a_resolution_and_verification: 1. Request approved existing recovery bucket identity and scoped storage.buckets.get / storage.buckets.getIamPolicy authority or owner metadata.
2. Verify distinct identity: bucket name MUST NOT equal ODP_STAGING_TERRAFORM_STATE_BUCKET (satisfying deploy-dev.yml:1207-1212 separation guard).
3. Verify security baseline: CMEK encryption (using runtime KMS key), Object Versioning enabled, Uniform Bucket-Level Access (UBLA), Public Access Prevention (enforced), and 30-day Retention policy.
4. Verify least-privilege IAM: roles/storage.objectUser granted to github-deployer SA (github-deployer@odayplus-runtime-20260825.iam.gserviceaccount.com).
5. If existing compliant bucket is confirmed, proceed to bind ODP_STAGING_RECOVERY_BUNDLE_BUCKET.
stage_b_conditional_provisioning: 1. If and only if absence is confirmed by owner metadata/readback AND explicit provisioning authority is granted by Human/Ops, provision a distinct GCS bucket (suggested naming pattern: oday-staging-recovery-odayplus-runtime-20260825).
2. Apply complete security baseline (CMEK, versioning, UBLA, PAP enforced, 30d retention, deployer objectUser IAM).
3. Bind ODP_STAGING_RECOVERY_BUNDLE_BUCKET in GitHub staging environment.

staging_build.analysis: The build job binds 'staging-build', which was not enumerated in Preflight #1245 (receipt_ref: null). Cloud Run Direct VPC uses ODP_STAGING_VPC_NETWORK and ODP_STAGING_VPC_SUBNETWORK rather than Serverless VPC Access Connectors. Tooling reconciliation belongs to a dedicated release-tooling task.

prerequisites_checklist: 1. Verify caller has Human/Ops authority with staging environment write permissions.
2. Perform live metadata verification of VPC, Subnet, KMS Key, Deployer SA, and State Bucket coordinates.
3. Execute Recovery Bucket Stage A resolution protocol (request identity & verify baseline; do not assume absence).
4. Confirm legacy Cloud SQL oday-staging-sql vs foundation SQL oday-staging-foundation-sql distinction and approve rebind.
5. Ensure Human Review Gates and release lease signatures remain active.
